name: IUGC
description: A benchmark for landmark detection and end-to-end intrapartum ultrasound biometry to evaluate algorithms on ultrasound landmarking and measurement.
reputation: Specialized benchmark within fetal/intrapartum ultrasound research with relevance to clinical ultrasound biometry tasks but limited broader adoption.
notes: Clinical medical-imaging benchmark — non-LLM; results depend on expert annotations and ultrasound acquisition variability; may have limited dataset size and domain-specific acquisition artifacts.
